p0_smoke.desc: P0 smoke: persisting-L2 check, GEMV bench, toy hybrid graph, gpu pytest

p0_l2.desc: P0.2 persisting-L2 exit check on one GPU

e1.desc: E1 two-tier sweep: hot set W (persisting off/0.5/0.75/1.0/1.0L) + 512 MiB cold set per token, one CUDA graph

e2_08b.desc: E2 Qwen3.5-0.8B BF16 decode vs context, bytes split by diffing contexts

e2_2b.desc: E2 Qwen3.5-2B BF16 decode vs context, bytes split by diffing contexts

e3.desc: E3 GDN state and LM head residency (bf16/int8/48k heads)

e3d.desc: E3d fully resident ternary draft step (D 16-160 MiB) off/on persisting, steady and after a 6 GiB verify pass, PDL 0/1

e4_pq2.desc: E4 Bonsai 2 27B PQ2_0 llama-bench sweep and ncu kernel split

e4_ptq1.desc: E4 Bonsai 2 27B PTQ1_0 llama-bench sweep and ncu kernel split

e4_pdl.desc: E4 PDL A/B: llama-bench tg128 at depth 0/32K with GGML_CUDA_PDL=0, =1, =1 plus GGML_CUDA_PDL_PREFETCH=1/4 and a PDL=0 plus prefetch=4 control, Bonsai 2 27B PQ2_0/PTQ1_0 and the E5 draft alone; test-backend-ops MUL_MAT(_ID) and fused mat-vec prefetch off/on; needs --allow-long (failsafe 70: clone, cold CUDA build, ~16 GB of downloads, 40 llama-bench runs)

e5_base.desc: E5 baseline: Bonsai 2 27B PQ2_0 without speculation, 200 prompts

e5_k4.desc: E5 speculative decoding K=4 with Qwen3.5-0.8B BF16 draft

e5_k6.desc: E5 speculative decoding K=6 with Qwen3.5-0.8B BF16 draft

e5_k8.desc: E5 speculative decoding K=8 with Qwen3.5-0.8B BF16 draft

e5_cost.desc: E5 step cost: Bonsai 2 27B PQ2_0 verify batch cost for widths 1-9 (llama-bench -p W -n 0 -d 512), the Qwen3.5-0.8B draft decode cost and draft batch cost for widths 1-9 (BF16, Q8_0; the draft re-eval of each verify batch); break-even acceptance per K with and without the re-eval term

r1.desc: R1 pre-E6 measurements on one PRO 6000: (b) E5 matrix on N fixed-seed prompts sized from a cost model, plus extra code_fix/refactor prompts (20 per category) for base and the n-gram configs: target alone, draft-simple K=4 (control), K=4 with target backend sampling (-bs), K=4 with the post-hoc PTQ1_0 draft, ngram-mod / ngram-map-k on the code categories (per-category r, alpha, tok/s, speedup with bootstrap CI, output equality, rollback path from the n_rs_seq log line; K=2/3 are opt-in via --configs); (a) Qwen3.5-0.8B BF16/Q8_0/post-hoc PTQ1_0 top-1 agreement and KL vs Bonsai 2 27B PQ2_0 (llama-perplexity, 8192 tokens, E5 chat text built from part b outputs); (c) one nsys capture of ~20 K=4 steps split by stream role into verify, draft re-eval, draft steps, copies and idle; needs --allow-long (failsafe 55 = clone, apt, torch and cold CUDA build ~14 (850 s measured) + downloads <= 6 (fetch_models --timeout-min 6) + r1 29 + end reserve 5; est 35 = downloads 6 + r1 29)

r2a.desc: R2a long-context agentic prompts on one PRO 6000 (exps/data/prompts_r2a.jsonl: 40 code edits embedding one repo file of 2-8K tokens, the modified file from the edit on or a unified diff, and 20 multi-turn tool-call traces in the native tool format; n_predict 320 / 512 / 128, ctx 16384, every server with -lv 4): (m) target alone, draft-simple K=4 (Qwen3.5-0.8B BF16; K=2/3 opt-in via --configs), ngram-mod (default and short parameters) and ngram-map-k (short; default parameters and K=2/3 on a follow-up pod), seeded prompt and config order, base again at the end as a drift bound, per category and overall tok/s, speedup, r, alpha with bootstrap 95% CIs, greedy equality against target alone, spec path and rollback (n_rs_seq, seq_rm lines) from the logs, prompt count sized from a cost model (17 per category planned, cut evenly; whole configs are dropped before prompts fall below 15 per category); (c) same-pod overhead control: unprofiled K=4 on a fixed 10-prompt subset followed by the nsys capture of the same requests (allowlisted env, private dir, decode steps only); (p) -lv 5 probe (LLAMA_TRACE=1, private log dir) counting speculative checkpoint create/restore events and replay steps; needs --allow-long (failsafe 55 = clone, apt, torch and cold CUDA build ~14 + downloads <= 6 (fetch_models --timeout-min 6) + r2a 29 + end reserve 5; est 35 = downloads 6 + r2a 29)

r2b_mc.desc: R2b multicol: PQ2_0 multi-column mat-vec (mmvq-pq2_0.cuh) on sm_120 behind GGML_CUDA_PQ2_MULTICOL=1 (default off), Bonsai 2 27B PQ2_0, configs off / on / on with GGML_CUDA_PDL=0: (t) test-backend-ops MUL_MAT filtered to pq2_0 against the CPU backend, (k) nsys kernel names of llama-bench -p 4 (the mc kernel must run only with the env; private dir, deleted), (b) llama-bench -p 1..9 -n 0 -r 5 and -p 0 -n 128 -r 5 in two rounds (ms per width, gain of on over off), (f) test-backend-ops perf MUL_MAT pq2_0 (us per op); needs --allow-long (failsafe 55 = clone, apt, torch and cold CUDA build ~14 + download <= 6 + run 22 + end reserve 5; est 28 = download 6 + run 22)

r2b_spec.desc: R2b spec on one PRO 6000: a balanced R2a subset (8 prompts per category, the first 24 of the R2a seeded order, same prompts and order for every config, -lv 4): (m) target alone, draft-simple K=4 with the Qwen3.5-0.8B BF16 draft (anchor to R2a), K=4 with the ggml-org Q8_0 draft (HF API check, llama-quantize fallback), and --spec-type ngram-mod,draft-simple (ngram-mod fork defaults, K=4), base again at the end as a drift bound, per category and overall tok/s, speedup, r, alpha with bootstrap 95% CIs, greedy equality against target alone, anchor ratios against the R2a rows of the same prompts; (p) -lv 5 probe (LLAMA_TRACE=1, private log dir) of k4, ngram-mod (fork defaults), the two short n-gram configs and the combined type: which implementation drafted, draft lengths against n_rs_seq, truncation, checkpoints created and restored; needs --allow-long (failsafe 55 = clone, apt, torch and cold CUDA build ~14 + downloads <= 6 + run 22 + end reserve 5; est 28 = downloads 6 + run 22)

wrap_a.desc: Wrap A (A1 + A2), fork PR evidence for the PQ2_0 multi-column kernel on sm_120 (GGML_CUDA_PQ2_MULTICOL prototype, pdl_sync) on one 600 W PRO 6000 (Workstation or Server; the driver refuses a Max-Q; cascade capped at the community price ~1.75/hr): (t) test-backend-ops MUL_MAT pq2_0 on three times, off; (b) paired llama-bench -p 1..9 -n 0 -r 5 and tg128, off/on alternating over 4 rounds, gain per round, health checked before and during (an unhealthy round is left out, UNHEALTHY HOST verdict, exit 1); (s) llama-server on the R2a balanced subset (12 prompts, -lv 4): target alone, draft-simple K=4 Q8_0 draft with the kernel off and on, interleaved by 2 prompt blocks, speedup with bootstrap CIs, ms per step split from the server statistics; no --allow-long (failsafe 40 = clone, apt, torch and cold CUDA build ~15 + downloads <= 6 + run 12 + end reserve 5; est 18 = downloads 6 + run 12)

wrap_a3.desc: Wrap A3, Ada regression check of the multi-column PR change on one RTX 4090: head = the bootstrap build of this branch, base = a copy of the tree with exps/data/a3_pq2_multicol.patch reversed (common.cuh and mmvq-pq2_0.cuh of 4a4866a60), built on the pod with the same cmake flags (llama-bench and test-backend-ops only, ccache, model download during the build); (sass) cuobjdump -sass of mul_mat_vec_pq2_0_mc from both builds (must be identical on sm_89); (t) test-backend-ops MUL_MAT pq2_0 both builds; (b) llama-bench -p 1..9 -n 0 -r 5 and tg128, base/head alternating over 4 rounds; (f) test-backend-ops perf; needs --allow-long (failsafe 55 = clone, apt, torch and cold CUDA build ~14 + run 28 incl. base build up to 14 + end reserve 5)

wrap_b.desc: Wrap B, test build for the upstream investigations on a Max-Q PRO 6000 or an RTX 5090 (no 600 W gate: every comparison is paired inside the pod, not PR evidence): (r) rollback probe (cr_rs_rollback_probe): n_rs_seq 4 on the Q8_0 draft and the PQ2_0 target (one-token decodes vs one batch), n_rs_seq 16 and 64 on the target (verify batches, rollbacks up to n-1); (m) R2a balanced subset (24 prompts, -lv 4) interleaved by 2 prompt blocks: target alone, draft-simple K=4 Q8_0 draft, with GGML_EXP_DRAFT_CKPT=1 (correct draft state), with GGML_EXP_DRAFT_CKPT=1 and GGML_EXP_DRAFT_TIME=1 (draft-context decode of the verify batch timed), ngram-mod (checkpoint path), with GGML_EXP_NGRAM_RS=16 and 64 (B2); alpha as the draft-state check, per-category speedups and pairs with bootstrap CIs, ms per step split, ngram-mod resets, path verification; needs --allow-long (failsafe 55 = clone, apt, torch and cold CUDA build ~15 + downloads <= 6 + run 22 + end reserve 5; est 28 = downloads 6 + run 22)

wrap_ab.cmd: python3 -m exps.fetch_models --models pq2,draft_q8_0 --timeout-min 6 && { python3 -m exps.wrap_a --budget-min 12; a=$?; python3 -m exps.wrap_b --budget-min 22; b=$?; exit $((a ? a : b)); }
wrap_ab.desc: Wrap A then wrap B in one 600 W PRO 6000 session: one clone, bootstrap, cold CUDA build and download for both (about 15 + 6 min of the pod time are shared); wrap_b runs even when wrap_a stops on an unhealthy host; the exit code is wrap_a's if it failed, else wrap_b's. Results go to results/wrap_a and results/wrap_b. Use it instead of the two single entries when the 600 W card is wanted for B as well; needs --allow-long (failsafe 60 = bootstrap and build ~15 + downloads <= 6 + wrap_a 12 + wrap_b 22 + end reserve 5)
